title: British Airways hand baggage dimensions
content: British Airways publishes a general allowance of one small handbag or backpack up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm that must fit under the seat, plus one cabin bag up to 56 x 45 x 25 cm. The cabin bag may need to be placed in the hold, and passengers must be able to lift it into the overhead locker without assistance.

title: British Airways Basic fare checked baggage
content: British Airways states that its hand-baggage-only Economy Basic fare does not include a checked baggage allowance. Other checked baggage allowances depend on the route, cabin and ticket, so the passenger should verify the allowance shown in Manage My Booking or on the ticket.

title: British Airways baggage on connecting bookings
content: British Airways says bags can generally be checked through when all flights share one booking reference and ticket number, or when oneworld flights share one booking reference. Separate flights with different booking references require collecting and checking bags again, subject to airport entry procedures.

title: British Airways online check-in opening time
content: British Airways online and app check-in generally opens 24 hours before departure. Airport check-in closing times vary by airport and route, and the exact deadline should be checked in Manage My Booking.

title: British Airways airport check-in deadlines
content: British Airways lists airport-specific check-in deadlines. London Heathrow and Gatwick close 60 minutes before long-haul departures and 45 minutes before short-haul departures; many long-haul international airports require at least 60 minutes. Exceptions exist, so the exact booking deadline must be checked before travel.

title: British Airways Silver tier mapping
content: British Airways Club Silver corresponds to oneworld Sapphire status.

title: oneworld Sapphire lounge access
content: oneworld says Sapphire members may use Business Class or frequent-flyer lounges when departing on a flight both marketed and operated by a oneworld member airline. Arrivals lounges and some named facilities are excluded, and capacity or other exceptions may apply.

title: oneworld Sapphire lounge guest policy
content: oneworld states that Emerald and Sapphire members may invite one guest to an eligible lounge. The guest must also travel on a flight marketed and operated by a oneworld carrier, and other policy exceptions may apply.

title: Qatar Airways oneworld membership
content: Qatar Airways is a member airline of the oneworld alliance.

title: Lufthansa long-haul Economy carry-on baggage
content: For long-haul Economy and Premium Economy, Lufthansa publishes one personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm and one carry-on bag up to 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm. Aircraft or authority restrictions can create exceptions.

title: Lufthansa long-haul Business and First carry-on baggage
content: For long-haul Business and First Class, Lufthansa publishes one personal item up to 40 x 30 x 15 cm plus two carry-on bags, each up to 8 kg and 55 x 40 x 23 cm. Aircraft or authority restrictions can create exceptions.
